name: Athena's Revenge
source:
The game takes place after the events of [url=/v31999]Euryale's Gambit[/url]. Stheno and Euryale join with Ashmedai and with the help of the Succubus Queen Igret Bat Mahlat, portal into Hell. There they meet a strange demon who calls himself "Aden" who agrees to help them. The small group battles countless hordes of demons as they close in on the Demonic Citadel where the Demon Lords are holding Athena imprisoned.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414260/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在[url=/v31999]Euryale's Gambit[/url]事件之后。斯泰诺和欧律阿勒与阿什梅黛一起，并在魅魔女王伊格雷特·巴特·玛拉特的帮助下，进入了地狱之门。在那里，他们遇到了一个自称“亚丁”的奇怪恶魔，他同意帮助他们。当他们逼近恶魔领主囚禁雅典娜的恶魔城堡时，小队与无数恶魔大军作战。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414260/]Steam[/url]]
